plugins.name: github-reports
plugins.description: Read-only GitHub digests: repo activity and project ticket movement, each usable on its own.

plugins.name: platform-ops
plugins.description: JoyStream platform alert diagnosis for the ops agent: read-only Railway evidence, one reply in the alert's Slack thread.

plugins.name: release-announcements
plugins.description: Customer-friendly GitHub release roundups for a date range, posted as one colored Slack message.

plugins.name: website-audits
plugins.description: Website audits that judge pages and search results the agent already fetched, such as AI answer-engine (AEO/GEO) readiness.

plugins.name: content-studio
plugins.description: Social content from real work: decide whether recent GitHub activity is worth a post, then draft LinkedIn and X posts in the author's voice (a voice profile built once), and check drafts for AI slop. Drafts only; nothing is posted.

plugins.name: content-operations
plugins.description: Around the drafts: pick timely news where the author has a point of view, plan next week's content from performance, market and customer input, record what an approved post published, and review what worked over time. Judgments only; nothing is posted.

plugins.name: gtm-research
plugins.description: Go-to-market research judgments over evidence the agent already fetched: account discovery, lookalikes of your best customers, ICP qualification, pre-call briefs, company profiles, trigger events (with no repeats between runs), who holds a role, public profiles of people, whether a person owns the problem you solve, warm paths through your own network, and ICP revisions proposed from real outcomes for a person to approve, each cited or marked unknown.

plugins.name: market-intelligence
plugins.description: Watch competitors: what each one changed in the last N days (pricing, launches, positioning, funding, people), with a "so what" against your positioning and no repeats between runs.

plugins.name: weekly-intelligence
plugins.description: Weekly reads across what other agents and teams posted: a product report that links customer pains, competitor moves and shipped work, and one brief for a leader from many channels.

plugins.name: meeting-intelligence
plugins.description: Before and after meetings: pick the external meetings to prep, brief each one, file internal huddle notes with decisions and owners, and turn customer calls into anonymized, counted insights.

plugins.name: community-signals
plugins.description: Find people on Hacker News (and Reddit, when reachable) asking for or struggling without a product like yours, scored for buying intent, pain and vendor promotion with the author's own words. Reads free public search APIs; never posts or contacts anyone.

plugins.name: gtm-outreach
plugins.description: Outreach and follow-up drafts for founders and sellers: a first-touch email or LinkedIn DM from a brief, and a sales-call debrief with a follow-up email. Drafts only; nothing is sent.

plugins.name: batch-processing
plugins.description: Generic fan-out helpers for list agents: prepare a list into bound slots, then rank the per-item results into one list.

plugins.name: channel-delivery
plugins.description: Render any skill's channel-neutral report as Slack, Teams, Discord, email-draft or markdown content, inside each channel's limits; the agent's delivery step posts it.

plugins.name: skill-doctor
plugins.description: Help authors make their own skills conformant: draft the judgment fixes (a vague description, a body that fetches, a missing output schema) as a diff to review. Drafts only; nothing is edited or pushed.

plugins.name: file-export
plugins.description: Save the document an agent wrote (a Markdown report, CSV, JSON, text or HTML) as a downloadable file in the run, unchanged.
